title: Find an artifact introduction
responsibility: Report a creation commit only when bounded artifact history shows one complete introduction.

inputs.name: hubArtifactCommit.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubArtifactCommit.path
inputs.description: Artifact path to inspect in the pinned history.

outputs.name: hubArtifactCommit
outputs.description: The sole history commit hash when the two-entry history request is complete and contains exactly one commit; otherwise null, including adapters without history support.
